name: Fairbanks
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fairbanks for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Visit Santa at Santa Claus House in North Pole) through December 31 (the same visit), with the Handmade Holiday Market at Alaskaland (November 28), the Santa Swim at Hamme Pool (December 4), A Christmas Carol at Fairbanks Drama Association (December 4 to 20), the Winter Solstice Festival (December 11 to 19) and the Jingle Jamboree at the Fairbanks Children's Museum (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or an official calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fairbanks

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Fairbanks
  • 2 free events: the Handmade Holiday Market with free Santa and train rides, and the Winter Solstice Festival
  • Meet Santa: Santa Claus House in North Pole (daily from November 27 to December 31, closed December 25 to 27) and the Handmade Holiday Market (November 28)
  • Trains: free train rides at the Handmade Holiday Market at Alaskaland (November 28)
  • Shows and music: A Christmas Carol (December 4 to 20) and the Design Alaska Holiday Concert by the Fairbanks Symphony Orchestra (December 5)
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to December 31, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Fairbanks families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids across Alaska, which covers Anchorage, Wasilla and Seward.
